title: kv-cache: adaptive defragmentation, paging & spillover eviction heuristics (v13)
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Reduce OOMs and tail-latency spikes caused by KV cache fragmentation and inefficient spillover/paging under bursty workloads. This PR implements an adaptive eviction and defragmentation pipeline that balances memory compaction, targeted paging to NVMe, and an eviction priority function based on recency, size, and fragmentation score. The goal is to improve steady-state throughput and tail latency for multi-tenant serving without increasing average token cost.

Summary of changes: 
- Add fragmentation scoring to KV entries and per-shard fragmentation metrics (runtime/kv_cache/fragmentation.rs).
- Implement adaptive defragmentation pass: opportunistic in-place coalescing during low-util windows, scheduled compaction during background IO budgets (runtime/kv_cache/defrag.rs).
- Paging/spillover improvements: asynchronous NVMe spillover with prioritization and backpressure-aware prefetching; per-tenant spill queues and rate limiting (runtime/kv_cache/spillover_nvme.rs).
- New eviction policy: weightedEvict(recency, size, frag_score) with hysteresis and tenant fairness knobs; integrates with scheduling to avoid evicting active prefixes (runtime/kv_cache/eviction_policy.rs).
- Scheduler integration: continuous batching now tags requests with expected KV hit-rate; scheduler prefers batches with high-hit affinity and isolates heavy-eviction work to dedicated background slots (runtime/scheduler/batching.rs).
- Kernel-level micro-opt: prefetch-friendly kernel selection for KV lookups that reduces latency when there is high cold miss rate (runtime/kernels/kv_lookup_opt.rs).
- Observability: add fragmentation, spill_read/write_qps, and defrag_compaction_time metrics + dashboards (observability/metrics/kv_cache_metrics.yaml, redwood-console/dashboard/kv-cache-fragmentation.json).
- Tests & benchmarks: unit tests for eviction logic, integration tests for spillover under load, benchmark harness with representative token distributions (integration-tests/kv_cache_eviction_test.py, benchmarks/kv_cache_perf.py).

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4128)
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Benchmarks comparing v12 -> v13 on tail P95/P99 and OOM rates
- [x] Metrics + dashboards added
- [x] Rollout plan with canary and feature flag

Backward compatibility & rollout: Changes behind an opt-in feature flag kv_cache.adaptive_eviction.v13. Default remains v12 behaviour; rollout plan uses progressive canaries: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with monitoring alerts on memory growth, eviction churn, and latency regressions.

Benchmarks: On the benchmark harness this change reduces observed P99 KV lookup latency by ~18% in high-fragmentation workloads and reduces OOMs from 6/hour to 0 over a 6-hour stress test on dedicated capacity with mixed tenants. Average per-token cost change is within +/-1%. Full benchmark outputs attached to the CI artifacts.

Notes: This is v13 of the eviction stack and builds on earlier defrag & spillover iterations. Keys for follow-ups: tuning compaction budget heuristics for low-memory GPUs, increasing tenant isolation during aggressive compaction, and extending spillover to remote object store for archival workloads.

review_comments: Miguel Santos: Can you explain how frag_score is computed and whether it can be gamed by noisy tenants?

Aisha Kapoor: frag_score = (num_fragments / contiguous_bytes) * log(1 + access_recency_score). We also clamp and normalize per-tenant to prevent pathological weighting; added unit tests to validate attack surface.
Evelyn Park: We're seeing increased IO from compaction on medium nodes in the 10% canary. Can we add a fast path to abort compaction if host IO exceeds threshold?
Aisha Kapoor: Added compaction IO budget and abort threshold; compaction now reports compaction_io_bytes metric. See defrag.rs changes (commit b6a3d11).
Jordan Liu: Suggest to add a per-tenant eviction cap to avoid one noisy tenant triggering global spillover.
ci_checks: perf-regression-check: pass (P99 improved on target workloads)
merge_details: Merged after approvals from Miguel and Evelyn and green CI. Rollout gated by feature flag; initial 1% canary completed; metrics stable before progressive rollout.
release_notes: Adaptive KV cache eviction and defragmentation (v13): improves tail latency and reduces OOMs under fragmented workloads. Disabled by default behind kv_cache.adaptive_eviction.v13 flag. See docs/kv-cache.md for tuning knobs and rollout guidance.
notes_for_ops: Rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated rollback on spike in eviction churn or memory growth
Mitigation: disable feature flag to revert to v12 behavior; set compaction_io_budget to 0 to stop background compaction
